value.summary: This pull request re-exports two modules out of a crate-internal `openhuman` submodule from a shorter path, changing two `use` statements. The lookups confirm that `openhuman_core::security` and `openhuman_core::tools` are public modules exposed at the crate root, so the new paths are valid and equivalent. No security problem, no authentication change, no new network or subprocess call, no deserialization, no path traversal, no secrets leak, and no widened permissions. The change is safe to merge.
